title: Task-record scopes must not serialize the swarm
goal: A worker's claim on the .agents/tasks directory overlaps every other task's own record file, so one GMCP worker holding that scope refused every claim in the swarm while it walked the lane. Treat task-record paths as per-id and non-conflicting in the claim overlap check, with tests that a directory record scope no longer blocks another task's record while real code overlap is still refused.
